profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
● Developed a new feature using React, JavaScript and Hack (PHP) that automated responses to CTX ads on Instagram,
 resulting in a 16% increase in meaningful conversations with potential customers and a 3% increase in daily revenue from
 CTXads.
 ● Implemented Unified Creation (multi-destination) ad creation on Ads Manager App using React, streamlining the ad creation
 process. This resulted in a 12K (5.5%) increase in the number of deep conversations and a 32K (211%) increase in daily
 revenue.
 ● Optimized the destination defaulting logic for CTX ads on Ads Manager by removing an activeness check on Instagram,
 resulting in an increase of 18K (39%) in daily revenue and a 38% increase in the number of daily deep conversations.
 ● Facilitated discussion in weekly experiment meetings around the status of features in public testing and aided in
 decision-making on whether to launch/expand each feature, leading to the release of dozens of features.
 ● Directed the software testing cycle for the team, overseeing onboarding, effective test writing, and the distribution of testing
 responsibilities to ensure timely completion; led to 100% end-to-end test coverage for all P0 (high-priority) features.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · React.js · Python · HTML CSS · TypeScript

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for Computer Science
positions.description:
Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for CS312: Intro to Programming and CS314: Data Structures

• Lead weekly discussion sections and administer quizzes in them in order to teach introductory concepts and data structures in Java
• Grade students' weekly programming assignments for correctness and code hygiene
• Teach overviews on Java concepts, code review with students, and debug students' code through lab hours twice a week
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching · Debugging · Mentoring · Pair Programming · Communication

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed two new upload strategies, deduplication and atomicity, for an internal tool in order to remove duplicate jobs which comprised of ~15% of the hundreds and thousands of jobs ingested weekly
• Created UI component that exposed the option for upload strategies using React, built the backend component of it in Hack (PHP) and Python, and wrote unit and integration tests to ensure the new feature worked end-to-end

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Built a tool that used natural language processing (NLP) to bucket and visualize the ticket compression that could be done by Hanzo, Toyota Connected's AI-driven dev-ops platform.
• Analyzed hundreds of thousands of ticket entries to explore how Hanzo could optimize potential clients.
• Created statistical and data models for infrastructure issues.
positions.insights: Skills: NumPy · Data Analysis · Python · Natural Language Processing (NLP)
